Overview of the UPSSSC PET 2026 Examination

The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has officially released the admit cards and exam city details for the Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) 2026 under Advertisement Number 16 Exam/2026. Registered applicants can now access their credentials via the official portal ahead of the upcoming tests.

The examination is scheduled to take place on October 25, October 30, and November 1, 2026. This follows the conclusion of the application window, which had its final submission deadline on September 7, 2026.

Accessing Admit Cards and Credentials

To view and download the admit card or check exam city details, candidates need to log into the official portal using specific personal credentials. The required information typically includes:

  • Enrollment Number
  • Registration Number
  • Date of Birth

Once logged in, examinees can view their designated exam date, shift timing, and test center location. It is strongly advised to print or save a digital copy of the admit card for future reference and carry it to the examination center along with valid identification.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

For candidates preparing to take the test, verifying all details printed on the admit card is crucial. Any discrepancies in name spelling, date of birth, or photograph should be reported immediately to the commission through official channels.

What is Confirmed vs. Unknown

  • Confirmed: The examination dates are October 25, October 30, and November 1, 2026. Admit cards and exam city details are currently available.
  • Unknown: Specific shift timings for individual candidates depend on their specific hall tickets, and the exact date for the final result declaration has not yet been specified.

How to Check the Original Announcement

Readers and applicants should always rely on verified primary sources for updates. You can cross-verify all notifications, exam schedules, and download links directly on the official UPSSSC website at https://upsssc.gov.in or via portal updates referenced on Sarkari Result.
